mocks.p: Which statement about “Value and contra funds” is correct?
o: A gilt fund invests mainly in low-rated corporate bonds.
A value fund buys only stocks at record highs.
An overnight fund holds bonds of ten years' maturity.
A value fund follows a value strategy, and a contra fund follows a contrarian one, each investing at least 65% in equity; a fund house can offer only one of these two.
mocks.w: Correct: A value fund follows a value strategy, and a contra fund follows a contrarian one, each investing at least 65% in equity; a fund house can offer only one of these two.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? In India a mutual fund is constituted as a public trust under the Indian Trusts Act, and the trust is registered with SEBI.
o: Sponsor
Sponsor's contribution
Mutual fund as a trust
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA)
mocks.w: Mutual fund as a trust: In India a mutual fund is constituted as a public trust under the Indian Trusts Act, and the trust is registered with SEBI.

mocks.p: A reader wants the sponsor's and trustees' details, not any one scheme's. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: NFO price
Allotment timeline
Asset allocation pattern
Statement of Additional Information (SAI)
mocks.w: This is Statement of Additional Information (SAI). The SAI holds information common to the fund house and all its schemes: constitution, sponsor, trustees, AMC, service providers and legal details.

mocks.p: A salaried person builds a retirement corpus with regulated pension fund managers. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Tax efficiency
Inflation
Gold
NPS
mocks.w: This is NPS. The National Pension System is a pension scheme regulated by PFRDA where contributions are invested in equity, corporate bonds and government securities and annuity is purchased on retirement.

mocks.p: A client may invest through a bank branch, an independent adviser or an app. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Suitability
Regular plan
Distributor channels
Know Your Distributor
mocks.w: This is Distributor channels. Mutual fund distribution channels include independent financial advisers, national distributors, banks, and online platforms and direct AMC routes.

mocks.p: A client's portfolio is reviewed every year and after the birth of a child. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Time value of money
Step-up SIP
Financial plan
Periodic review
mocks.w: This is Periodic review. A plan should be reviewed at least once a year and on major life events, and rebalanced to the target allocation.

mocks.p: A scheme allows transactions only during two intervals each year. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Economies of scale
Diversification
Risk in mutual funds
Interval scheme
mocks.w: This is Interval scheme. An interval scheme combines open and closed features: units can be bought or redeemed only during specified intervals, and units are listed on exchanges.

mocks.p: A debt fund's document warns about downgrade of issuers' ratings. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Statement of Additional Information (SAI)
Scheme Information Document (SID)
Key Information Memorandum (KIM)
Scheme-specific risk factors
mocks.w: This is Scheme-specific risk factors. The offer document lists the risks specific to the scheme, such as credit risk for debt schemes, so that investors make informed decisions.

mocks.p: Two fund houses holding the same bond use the same price from an independent agency. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: LTCG on equity funds
Debt valuation
Specified mutual fund
Ex-dividend NAV effect
mocks.w: This is Debt valuation. Debt securities are valued at prices provided by SEBI-approved valuation agencies appointed by AMFI, to ensure uniform valuation across funds.

mocks.p: A ₹10,000 investment grows to ₹12,000 in total, and the gain is expressed as 20%. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: XIRR
Alpha
Absolute return
CAGR
mocks.w: This is Absolute return. Absolute return is the percentage change in value over a period, ignoring how long it took. It is (end value − start value) ÷ start value.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? A distributor must disclose to the investor all commissions received from the AMC for the transaction, in a transparent manner.
o: Regular plan
Disclosure of commission
Upfront commission
Trail commission
mocks.w: Disclosure of commission: A distributor must disclose to the investor all commissions received from the AMC for the transaction, in a transparent manner.

mocks.p: A client earmarks a separate investment for a house purchase in seven years. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Goal-based planning
Emergency fund
Life-cycle stage
Periodic review
mocks.w: This is Goal-based planning. Goal-based planning sets investments against specific goals, such as a child's education, with a target amount, date and priority.

mocks.p: A couple opens a folio where either can redeem alone. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: STP
Redemption timeline
Nomination
Joint holding modes
mocks.w: This is Joint holding modes. In 'anyone or survivor' mode, any holder can operate the folio; in 'joint', all must sign. On a holder's death the units go to the survivors.

mocks.p: An investor expects IDCW proceeds a few days after the declared date. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Demat mode
Transmission
Nomination
Dividend or IDCW payout timeline
mocks.w: This is Dividend or IDCW payout timeline. Payout of IDCW must be dispatched within seven working days of the record date.

mocks.p: An investor's units are marked as security for a loan, and cannot be sold. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Lien
Demat mode
Cut-off time
Folio
mocks.w: This is Lien. A lien is a charge marked on units, for example when pledged as security for a loan, so they cannot be redeemed until the lien is removed.

mocks.p: A client works out how much he must save each month to retire at 60. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Emergency fund
Life-cycle stage
Retirement planning
Financial plan
mocks.w: This is Retirement planning. Retirement planning estimates the corpus needed to meet expenses after earning stops, allowing for inflation and longevity.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? AMCs carry out due diligence on distributors and check that their ARN, certification and code compliance are valid before accepting business.
o: Know Your Distributor
Distributor channels
Regular plan
Disclosure of commission
mocks.w: Know Your Distributor: AMCs carry out due diligence on distributors and check that their ARN, certification and code compliance are valid before accepting business.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Tax efficiency” is correct?
o: Time horizon has no effect on product choice.
The after-tax return matters more than the headline return; different products are taxed differently, so compare after-tax outcomes.
Only pre-tax returns matter in a comparison.
PPF can be withdrawn in full at any time.
mocks.w: Correct: The after-tax return matters more than the headline return; different products are taxed differently, so compare after-tax outcomes.

mocks.p: A scheme's net assets are ₹1,000 crore and it has 50 crore units outstanding, so the value per unit is ₹20. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Debt valuation
STCG on equity funds
NAV calculation
Equity-oriented fund
mocks.w: This is NAV calculation. NAV equals the market value of the scheme's assets less its liabilities, divided by units outstanding, and is declared every business day.

mocks.p: ₹1 lakh becomes ₹1.21 lakh in two years, which is 10% a year compounded. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Risk-return trade-off
Absolute return
CAGR
Sharpe ratio
mocks.w: This is CAGR. Compound Annual Growth Rate is the constant yearly rate at which an investment would have grown to reach its final value, used for periods over one year.

mocks.p: A 40-year-old starts discussing about 60% equity. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Age-based rule of thumb
Documenting advice
Tactical asset allocation
Model portfolio
mocks.w: This is Age-based rule of thumb. A rough guide sets equity at 100 minus the investor's age, adjusting for risk profile; it is a starting point, not a rule.

mocks.p: A scheme holds paper that matures the next day. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Gilt fund
Small cap fund
Overnight fund
Value and contra funds
mocks.w: This is Overnight fund. An overnight fund invests in securities with a maturity of one day, so interest-rate and credit risk are very low.

mocks.p: A firm prepares the scheme's accounts and an independent firm audits them. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Sponsor's contribution
Trustees
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA)
Fund accountant and auditor
mocks.w: This is Fund accountant and auditor. The fund accountant maintains the scheme's books and computes NAV, while auditors independently audit the accounts.

mocks.p: A scheme keeps about 70% in equity and the rest in debt. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Sectoral/thematic fund
Aggressive hybrid fund
Conservative hybrid fund
Overnight fund
mocks.w: This is Aggressive hybrid fund. An aggressive hybrid fund invests 65% to 80% in equity and 20% to 35% in debt.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Key Information Memorandum (KIM)” is correct?
o: The KIM replaces the need for any offer document.
A scheme at ₹10 is cheaper in value than one at ₹50.

The KIM is a short summary of the SID and SAI given with the application form so investors see the essentials first. SEBI has since moved towards a standard scheme summary document with the same purpose.
An NFO can stay open for six months.
mocks.w: Correct: The KIM is a short summary of the SID and SAI given with the application form so investors see the essentials first. SEBI has since moved towards a standard scheme summary document with the same purpose.

mocks.p: A distributor compares funds on several measures, not just last year's return. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Corporate bond fund
Index fund and ETF
Flexi cap fund
Selection criteria
mocks.w: This is Selection criteria. A good selection looks at risk-adjusted return, consistency over several periods, expense ratio, portfolio quality, fund manager continuity and fit with the investor's profile.

mocks.p: Two funds have the same return, but one takes less volatility to achieve it and has the higher ratio. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Sharpe ratio
Liquidity risk
Interest rate risk
Standard deviation
mocks.w: This is Sharpe ratio. The Sharpe ratio is the excess return over the risk-free rate per unit of standard deviation. A higher ratio means better risk-adjusted performance.

mocks.p: A scheme holds 50 stocks across many sectors, so one company's collapse barely moves its NAV. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Diversification
Net Asset Value (NAV)
Unit
Professional management
mocks.w: This is Diversification. Diversification means spreading investments across many securities, sectors or asset classes so that a fall in one has a limited effect on the whole portfolio.

mocks.p: A company runs the fund's portfolios and employs the fund managers. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Custodian
Asset Management Company (AMC)
Fund accountant and auditor
Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA)
mocks.w: This is Asset Management Company (AMC). The AMC is appointed by the trustees to manage the schemes' investments and operations. At least half of its directors must be independent of the sponsor.

mocks.p: A retiree redeems units worth ₹20,000 on the first of every month for expenses. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: SIP
Joint holding modes
SWP
Applicable NAV
mocks.w: This is SWP. A Systematic Withdrawal Plan redeems a fixed amount of units at regular intervals, giving the investor a regular cash flow.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Asset allocation” is correct?
o: Asset allocation matters less than picking the best fund.
Asset allocation is the division of a portfolio among asset classes such as equity, debt and gold, and is the main driver of risk and return over time.
A model portfolio guarantees returns.
Conflicts of interest need not be disclosed.
mocks.w: Correct: Asset allocation is the division of a portfolio among asset classes such as equity, debt and gold, and is the main driver of risk and return over time.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Documenting advice” is correct?
o: The distributor should record the client's profile, the recommendation and the reasons, and obtain the client's acknowledgement to show suitability.
No written record of advice is needed.
Strategic allocation changes with every market move.
Core and satellite means holding only satellite ideas.
mocks.w: Correct: The distributor should record the client's profile, the recommendation and the reasons, and obtain the client's acknowledgement to show suitability.

mocks.p: An investor sells equity fund units and a small tax is deducted on the sale value. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: STCG on equity funds
STT
Exit load
IDCW taxation
mocks.w: This is STT. Securities Transaction Tax is levied on the redemption of equity-oriented fund units; there is no STT on purchase, and none on debt funds.

mocks.p: An investor redeems within a year and has 1% deducted from the proceeds, which is returned to the scheme. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: LTCG on equity funds
STT
Exit load
Total expense ratio (TER)
mocks.w: This is Exit load. Exit load is a charge levied when units are redeemed within a stated period. It is credited to the scheme, not kept by the AMC.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Portfolio disclosure” is correct?
o: There is no limit on investing in cash.
Portfolios are disclosed once a year only.
Mutual funds publish portfolios of all schemes monthly on their websites and with AMFI, and publish the half-yearly financial results.
AMFI is the statutory regulator of mutual funds.
mocks.w: Correct: Mutual funds publish portfolios of all schemes monthly on their websites and with AMFI, and publish the half-yearly financial results.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? A unit is the smallest share of a mutual fund scheme's portfolio that an investor owns. The number of units held shows the investor's proportional ownership.
o: Unit
Liquidity
Risk in mutual funds
Interval scheme
mocks.w: Unit: A unit is the smallest share of a mutual fund scheme's portfolio that an investor owns. The number of units held shows the investor's proportional ownership.

mocks.p: Which statement about “ARN” is correct?
o: A distributor needs no registration to sell mutual funds.
The AMFI Registration Number is a unique number issued to a distributor who has passed the NISM certification and follows the Code of Conduct. It must be renewed periodically.
Fund houses can change fundamental attributes without informing investors.
There is no limit on investing in cash.
mocks.w: Correct: The AMFI Registration Number is a unique number issued to a distributor who has passed the NISM certification and follows the Code of Conduct. It must be renewed periodically.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? Trail commission is paid to a distributor as long as the investor stays invested, usually as a percentage of the assets he has brought in.
o: Regular plan
Distributor channels
Trail commission
Upfront commission
mocks.w: Trail commission: Trail commission is paid to a distributor as long as the investor stays invested, usually as a percentage of the assets he has brought in.

mocks.p: An investor buys directly from the fund house's website and pays no distributor commission. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Direct plan
Suitability
Mis-selling
Churning
mocks.w: This is Direct plan. A direct plan is bought directly from the AMC without a distributor, so no commission is paid and the expense ratio is lower.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? Liquidity risk is the chance a fund cannot sell securities quickly without a price discount, such as in thinly traded bonds.
o: Yield to maturity (YTM)
Absolute return
Liquidity risk
XIRR
mocks.w: Liquidity risk: Liquidity risk is the chance a fund cannot sell securities quickly without a price discount, such as in thinly traded bonds.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Credit risk” is correct?
o: Absolute return already adjusts for the length of time.
Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.
Government securities carry the highest credit risk.
Duration measures the credit rating of the bond.
mocks.w: Correct: Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.

mocks.p: A wealthy client who panics at small losses has high capacity but low tolerance. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Goal-based planning
Periodic review
Retirement planning
Risk capacity versus tolerance
mocks.w: This is Risk capacity versus tolerance. Risk capacity is the ability to bear loss financially, while risk tolerance is willingness to bear it emotionally; advice should respect the lower of the two.

mocks.p: A saver's fixed return of 5% leaves little real gain when prices rise 6%. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Bonds and debentures
Inflation
Real estate
Capital protection
mocks.w: This is Inflation. Inflation is the rise in prices over time, which erodes the purchasing power of money; investments must beat it to grow real wealth.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Scheme categorisation” is correct?
o: AMCs can name and define scheme types as they like.
AMFI is the statutory regulator of mutual funds.
Portfolios are disclosed once a year only.
SEBI groups schemes into equity, debt, hybrid, solution oriented and other categories with defined definitions, and each AMC may offer only one scheme per category, with a few exceptions.
mocks.w: Correct: SEBI groups schemes into equity, debt, hybrid, solution oriented and other categories with defined definitions, and each AMC may offer only one scheme per category, with a few exceptions.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Debt valuation” is correct?
o: Entry load of 2.25% is still allowed on purchases.
STT is charged on every purchase of mutual fund units.
Each AMC values bonds as it sees fit.
Debt securities are valued at prices provided by SEBI-approved valuation agencies appointed by AMFI, to ensure uniform valuation across funds.
mocks.w: Correct: Debt securities are valued at prices provided by SEBI-approved valuation agencies appointed by AMFI, to ensure uniform valuation across funds.

mocks.p: A client wants assured safety of principal and is shown a deposit instead of an equity fund. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Gold
Risk profiling
Capital protection
Time horizon
mocks.w: This is Capital protection. Mutual fund schemes do not protect capital; only specific instruments like bank deposits (up to the insured limit) and some government schemes offer greater safety.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Mis-selling” is correct?
o: A regular plan has the same expense ratio as the direct plan.
Mis-selling happens only when the product is illegal.
Churning benefits the investor through lower costs.
Mis-selling is selling a product that is unsuitable for the client or by misrepresenting its features, risk or returns.
mocks.w: Correct: Mis-selling is selling a product that is unsuitable for the client or by misrepresenting its features, risk or returns.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? A glide path gradually reduces equity and raises safer assets as a goal date approaches, to protect accumulated gains.
o: Model portfolio
Rebalancing
Conflict of interest
Glide path
mocks.w: Glide path: A glide path gradually reduces equity and raises safer assets as a goal date approaches, to protect accumulated gains.

mocks.p: An investor quotes her account number with a fund house to check her units. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: SWP
Redemption timeline
Consolidated Account Statement (CAS)
Folio
mocks.w: This is Folio. A folio is the account number allotted by an AMC to an investor, under which all that investor's units in that fund house are recorded.

mocks.p: A holder whose redemption was delayed lodges a complaint online with the regulator. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: EUIN
SEBI SCORES / ODR
SEBI
Riskometer
mocks.w: This is SEBI SCORES / ODR. Investors can file complaints against AMCs and intermediaries through SEBI's complaint system, and use the online dispute resolution platform if not satisfied.

mocks.p: A distributor prepares a written plan showing how each goal will be funded. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Financial plan
Emergency fund
Life-cycle stage
Retirement planning
mocks.w: This is Financial plan. A financial plan is a documented roadmap that links the client's goals, resources, risk profile and time horizon to a set of actions.

mocks.p: An investor wants the true annual return on a SIP made across many months. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: XIRR
Modified duration
CAGR
Sharpe ratio
mocks.w: This is XIRR. XIRR is the annualised return when there are multiple cash flows on different dates, such as SIP instalments.

mocks.p: A client's portfolio is split 60% equity, 30% debt and 10% gold. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Glide path
Core and satellite
Asset allocation
Rebalancing
mocks.w: This is Asset allocation. Asset allocation is the division of a portfolio among asset classes such as equity, debt and gold, and is the main driver of risk and return over time.

mocks.p: A debt scheme's document says at least 80% will be in a certain type of paper. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Asset allocation pattern
Statement of Additional Information (SAI)
Key Information Memorandum (KIM)
New Fund Offer (NFO)
mocks.w: This is Asset allocation pattern. The SID states the proportion of the scheme's assets to be held in each asset class and the permissible ranges, which are binding on the fund manager.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Tracking error” is correct?
o: Government securities carry the highest credit risk.
Tracking error is the standard deviation of the difference between an index fund's return and its benchmark's. A lower figure means closer replication.
Liquidity risk affects only equity funds.
A high tracking error is desirable for index funds.
mocks.w: Correct: Tracking error is the standard deviation of the difference between an index fund's return and its benchmark's. A lower figure means closer replication.

mocks.p: Two funds earn the same average return, but one swings far more from year to year. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Alpha
Interest rate risk
Standard deviation
Liquidity risk
mocks.w: This is Standard deviation. Standard deviation measures how much a fund's returns vary around its average. A higher figure means more volatility.

mocks.p: Which statement about “KYC” is correct?
o: The riskometer has only three levels: low, medium and high.
KYC is required only for investments above ₹10 lakh.
A distributor needs no registration to sell mutual funds.
Know Your Customer is mandatory for all mutual fund investors. It verifies identity and address, and the records are kept with a KYC registration agency.
mocks.w: Correct: Know Your Customer is mandatory for all mutual fund investors. It verifies identity and address, and the records are kept with a KYC registration agency.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Regular plan” is correct?
o: Mis-selling happens only when the product is illegal.
A regular plan is bought through a distributor, who is paid a commission from the scheme's expense ratio, making its expense ratio higher than the direct plan's.
A regular plan has the same expense ratio as the direct plan.
AMCs pay commissions without checking the distributor's registration.
mocks.w: Correct: A regular plan is bought through a distributor, who is paid a commission from the scheme's expense ratio, making its expense ratio higher than the direct plan's.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Credit risk fund” is correct?
o: A credit risk fund invests at least 65% in corporate bonds rated AA and below, seeking higher yields at higher credit risk.
A credit risk fund holds only AAA-rated bonds.
A large cap fund invests mainly in companies ranked 251 onwards.
Last year's top performer is always the best choice.
mocks.w: Correct: A credit risk fund invests at least 65% in corporate bonds rated AA and below, seeking higher yields at higher credit risk.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Liquidity” is correct?
o: A fund with a low NAV is cheaper and therefore a better buy.
An open-ended scheme can be redeemed only on maturity.
Liquidity in mutual funds means that units of open-ended schemes can be redeemed on any business day at the applicable NAV, subject to exit loads and settlement time.
All mutual fund units can be encashed instantly at any hour.
mocks.w: Correct: Liquidity in mutual funds means that units of open-ended schemes can be redeemed on any business day at the applicable NAV, subject to exit loads and settlement time.

mocks.p: An investor invests ₹10,000 and all of it is invested, with none deducted as load. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: NAV calculation
Equity-oriented fund
Entry load
Exit load
mocks.w: This is Entry load. SEBI has abolished entry load; no fee can be deducted from the investor's money at the time of purchase.

mocks.p: An investor lends to a company in return for coupons and the principal at maturity. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: PPF
Risk profiling
Bonds and debentures
Fixed deposit
mocks.w: This is Bonds and debentures. Bonds and debentures are debt securities paying periodic interest and returning principal at maturity; the issuer's credit rating drives their risk.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Fixed deposit” is correct?
o: A fixed deposit offers returns linked to the stock market.
A bank fixed deposit pays a fixed rate for a fixed term; interest is taxable at slab rates, and premature withdrawal usually attracts a penalty.
Inflation increases the real value of cash.
Bonds make the holder an owner of the company.
mocks.w: Correct: A bank fixed deposit pays a fixed rate for a fixed term; interest is taxable at slab rates, and premature withdrawal usually attracts a penalty.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Rebalancing” is correct?
o: Rebalancing means bringing the portfolio back to its target allocation by selling what has grown too large and buying what has fallen behind.
Asset allocation matters less than picking the best fund.
Rebalancing means adding only to the best performer.
Conflicts of interest need not be disclosed.
mocks.w: Correct: Rebalancing means bringing the portfolio back to its target allocation by selling what has grown too large and buying what has fallen behind.

mocks.p: A scheme mirrors the Nifty 50 with very low costs. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Liquid fund
Credit risk fund
Gilt fund
Index fund and ETF
mocks.w: This is Index fund and ETF. An index fund or ETF replicates a market index, investing at least 95% in the index's securities, with low cost and no stock picking.

mocks.p: A fund house changes a scheme's investment objective and gives holders a window to leave free of exit load. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Scheme categorisation
Product labelling
Fundamental attribute change
SEBI SCORES / ODR
mocks.w: This is Fundamental attribute change. A change in a scheme's fundamental attributes needs a written notice to unit holders and an exit option at the prevailing NAV without exit load for at least 30 days.

mocks.p: A 28-year-old and a 58-year-old need different mixes for the same sum. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Life-cycle stage
Emergency fund
Time value of money
Financial plan
mocks.w: This is Life-cycle stage. A client's life stage, such as starting a career, raising a family or nearing retirement, shapes goals, risk capacity and asset allocation.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Sectoral/thematic fund” is correct?
o: A conservative hybrid fund keeps 70% in equity.
A thematic fund is well diversified across all sectors.
A sectoral or thematic fund invests at least 80% in a particular sector or theme, such as banking or technology, and carries concentration risk.
An aggressive hybrid fund holds less than 40% in equity.
mocks.w: Correct: A sectoral or thematic fund invests at least 80% in a particular sector or theme, such as banking or technology, and carries concentration risk.

mocks.p: An investor buys a gold ETF to avoid storage and purity worries. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: PPF
Time horizon
Fixed deposit
Gold
mocks.w: This is Gold. Gold is held as a hedge against inflation and uncertainty; it can be owned through physical gold, gold ETFs, sovereign gold bonds or gold funds.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Corporate bond fund” is correct?
o: A large cap fund invests mainly in companies ranked 251 onwards.
A corporate bond fund invests at least 80% in the highest-rated (AA+ and above) corporate bonds.
A small cap fund must hold at least 80% in the top 100.
A corporate bond fund holds mostly AA-rated and below paper.
mocks.w: Correct: A corporate bond fund invests at least 80% in the highest-rated (AA+ and above) corporate bonds.

mocks.p: Which term is described here? Higher potential return generally comes with higher risk. Investors who want higher returns must accept greater volatility.
o: Modified duration
Total Return Index (TRI)
Risk-return trade-off
Interest rate risk
mocks.w: Risk-return trade-off: Higher potential return generally comes with higher risk. Investors who want higher returns must accept greater volatility.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Emergency fund” is correct?
o: A financial plan is a list of schemes with last year's returns.
An emergency fund is money kept in safe and liquid assets, usually three to six months of expenses, for unexpected needs.
Retirement planning needs no allowance for inflation.
An emergency fund should be invested in small-cap equity.
mocks.w: Correct: An emergency fund is money kept in safe and liquid assets, usually three to six months of expenses, for unexpected needs.

mocks.p: A distributor tells the client the commission he earns on the scheme. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: EUIN
Code of Conduct
SEBI
KYC
mocks.w: This is Code of Conduct. AMFI's Code of Conduct requires distributors to act honestly, disclose commissions, give suitable advice, and not mislead investors.

mocks.p: A big pooled fund pays lower dealing costs per rupee than a small individual investor. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Diversification
Economies of scale
Closed-ended scheme
Net Asset Value (NAV)
mocks.w: This is Economies of scale. Economies of scale mean that large pooled funds can buy securities in bulk and spread costs, lowering per-unit costs for investors.

mocks.p: An investor receives a dividend from a scheme and adds it to total income. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Slab-wise TER
Entry load
IDCW taxation
Exit load
mocks.w: This is IDCW taxation. Income distribution cum capital withdrawal payouts are added to the investor's income and taxed at the slab rate, with TDS where applicable.

mocks.p: A very large scheme is permitted a lower maximum expense ratio than a small one. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Slab-wise TER
STT
NAV calculation
Entry load
mocks.w: This is Slab-wise TER. SEBI sets maximum TER slabs that fall as a scheme's assets under management grow, so larger schemes charge a lower percentage.

mocks.p: A distributor files a signed risk profile and rationale for the recommended funds. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Strategic asset allocation
Documenting advice
Tactical asset allocation
Rebalancing
mocks.w: This is Documenting advice. The distributor should record the client's profile, the recommendation and the reasons, and obtain the client's acknowledgement to show suitability.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Financial plan” is correct?
o: An emergency fund should be invested in small-cap equity.
Risk tolerance and capacity are the same.
A financial plan is a list of schemes with last year's returns.
A financial plan is a documented roadmap that links the client's goals, resources, risk profile and time horizon to a set of actions.
mocks.w: Correct: A financial plan is a documented roadmap that links the client's goals, resources, risk profile and time horizon to a set of actions.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Risk capacity versus tolerance” is correct?
o: Risk capacity is the ability to bear loss financially, while risk tolerance is willingness to bear it emotionally; advice should respect the lower of the two.
Once made, a plan never needs revisiting.
Risk tolerance and capacity are the same.
Retirement planning needs no allowance for inflation.
mocks.w: Correct: Risk capacity is the ability to bear loss financially, while risk tolerance is willingness to bear it emotionally; advice should respect the lower of the two.

mocks.p: A fund holding a low-rated company's bonds suffers when the company defaults. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Liquidity risk
CAGR
Credit risk
Sharpe ratio
mocks.w: This is Credit risk. Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Listed equity shares are valued at the closing price on the principal stock exchange on the valuation day.
NAV equals the market value of the scheme's assets less its liabilities, divided by units outstanding, and is declared every business day.
A scheme with 40% equity is equity-oriented.
Gains on equity-oriented funds held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5% on the amount above ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: For tax purposes, an equity-oriented fund invests at least 65% of its assets in equity shares of domestic companies.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Closed-ended scheme” is correct?
o: A closed-ended scheme has a fixed maturity and units are bought during the NFO only; investors exit at maturity or by selling on a stock exchange where listed.
A closed-ended scheme allows fresh purchases daily from the fund house.
An open-ended scheme can be redeemed only on maturity.
Diversification removes all risk from a portfolio.
mocks.w: Correct: A closed-ended scheme has a fixed maturity and units are bought during the NFO only; investors exit at maturity or by selling on a stock exchange where listed.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The SID states the proportion of the scheme's assets to be held in each asset class and the permissible ranges, which are binding on the fund manager.
The SAI holds information common to the fund house and all its schemes: constitution, sponsor, trustees, AMC, service providers and legal details.
Allotment can be made after two months.
Units in an NFO are typically offered at ₹10 each, with no assurance that this is a better price than existing schemes' NAV.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Units must be allotted and refunds, if any, paid within five working days from the closure of the NFO.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Trustees” is correct?
o: Trustees decide which stocks the schemes buy.
Trustees hold the fund's property in trust for unit holders and supervise the AMC. At least two-thirds of the trustees must be independent of the sponsor.
The AMC holds the securities of the schemes.
The sponsor manages the investments of each scheme day to day.
mocks.w: Correct: Trustees hold the fund's property in trust for unit holders and supervise the AMC. At least two-thirds of the trustees must be independent of the sponsor.

mocks.p: A long-duration gilt fund loses value when the central bank raises rates. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Sharpe ratio
Interest rate risk
Beta
Risk-return trade-off
mocks.w: This is Interest rate risk. When interest rates rise, the prices of existing bonds fall and vice versa, which affects debt fund NAVs, especially of longer-duration funds.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: AMFI's Code of Conduct requires distributors to act honestly, disclose commissions, give suitable advice, and not mislead investors.
SEBI groups schemes into equity, debt, hybrid, solution oriented and other categories with defined definitions, and each AMC may offer only one scheme per category, with a few exceptions.
Stamp duty is charged on units only when redeemed.
Know Your Customer is mandatory for all mutual fund investors. It verifies identity and address, and the records are kept with a KYC registration agency.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Stamp duty is charged at 0.005% on the purchase of mutual fund units, including switches and SIP instalments.

mocks.p: A fund house cannot launch two large-cap schemes that differ only in name. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Scheme categorisation
KYC
Stamp duty on units
Cash investment limit
mocks.w: This is Scheme categorisation. SEBI groups schemes into equity, debt, hybrid, solution oriented and other categories with defined definitions, and each AMC may offer only one scheme per category, with a few exceptions.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Consolidated Account Statement (CAS)” is correct?
o: Redemption proceeds can take two months.
A single statement covering all of an investor's mutual fund holdings across AMCs, sent monthly if there were transactions, otherwise half-yearly.
A lien means the units have been sold.
The CAS covers only one fund house's schemes.
mocks.w: Correct: A single statement covering all of an investor's mutual fund holdings across AMCs, sent monthly if there were transactions, otherwise half-yearly.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: SEBI has abolished entry load; no fee can be deducted from the investor's money at the time of purchase.
TER is deducted separately from the investor's bank account.
SEBI sets maximum TER slabs that fall as a scheme's assets under management grow, so larger schemes charge a lower percentage.
Income distribution cum capital withdrawal payouts are added to the investor's income and taxed at the slab rate, with TDS where applicable.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: TER is the annual percentage of a scheme's average assets charged for management, distribution and operating costs, and it is reflected in the daily NAV.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: SEBI has banned upfront commission to distributors; commissions are now paid on a trail basis, to align the distributor's interest with the investor's.
Mutual fund distribution channels include independent financial advisers, national distributors, banks, and online platforms and direct AMC routes.
A person cannot be both a registered investment adviser and a distributor for the same client; roles and fees must be kept clearly separate to avoid conflicts of interest.
A direct plan always earns higher returns than a regular plan in every period.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A direct plan is bought directly from the AMC without a distributor, so no commission is paid and the expense ratio is lower.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Exit load is a charge levied when units are redeemed within a stated period. It is credited to the scheme, not kept by the AMC.
Gains on equity-oriented funds held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5% on the amount above ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year.
STT is charged on every purchase of mutual fund units.
When an IDCW is paid, the scheme's NAV falls by the amount paid, so the investor's wealth is unchanged before tax.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Securities Transaction Tax is levied on the redemption of equity-oriented fund units; there is no STT on purchase, and none on debt funds.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Strategic asset allocation sets long-term target weights based on the client's profile, which are maintained by periodic rebalancing.
Tactical allocation makes short-term deviations from the strategic weights to take advantage of market conditions.
Rebalancing means adding only to the best performer.
Asset allocation is the division of a portfolio among asset classes such as equity, debt and gold, and is the main driver of risk and return over time.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Rebalancing means bringing the portfolio back to its target allocation by selling what has grown too large and buying what has fallen behind.

mocks.p: A scheme holds 85% in the 100 biggest listed companies. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Index fund and ETF
Mid cap fund
Large cap fund
Gilt fund
mocks.w: This is Large cap fund. A large cap fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the top 100 companies by market capitalisation.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The sponsor is the person or entity that sets up the mutual fund and establishes the trust. It must meet SEBI's track-record and net-worth conditions.
The RTA maintains unit holders' records, processes purchases and redemptions, and sends statements on behalf of the AMC.
The sponsor must contribute at least 40% of the net worth of the AMC.
The custodian selects which securities the fund buys.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: The custodian safekeeps the securities and settles the trades of the schemes, and is independent of the sponsor.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A fixed deposit offers returns linked to the stock market.
Gold is held as a hedge against inflation and uncertainty; it can be owned through physical gold, gold ETFs, sovereign gold bonds or gold funds.
The National Pension System is a pension scheme regulated by PFRDA where contributions are invested in equity, corporate bonds and government securities and annuity is purchased on retirement.
Inflation is the rise in prices over time, which erodes the purchasing power of money; investments must beat it to grow real wealth.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A bank fixed deposit pays a fixed rate for a fixed term; interest is taxable at slab rates, and premature withdrawal usually attracts a penalty.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: AMCs carry out due diligence on distributors and check that their ARN, certification and code compliance are valid before accepting business.
Suitability means recommending a product that fits the client's goals, risk profile, time horizon and financial situation.
A distributor must disclose to the investor all commissions received from the AMC for the transaction, in a transparent manner.
Mis-selling happens only when the product is illegal.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Mis-selling is selling a product that is unsuitable for the client or by misrepresenting its features, risk or returns.

mocks.p: A client needs ₹50 lakh in 15 years and works out what to invest today. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Goal-based planning
Time value of money
Financial plan
Life-cycle stage
mocks.w: This is Time value of money. Money today is worth more than the same sum in the future because it can earn returns; planning must discount future needs and compound savings.

mocks.p: A distributor earns a small percentage every year on the client's holding. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Upfront commission
Distributor channels
Trail commission
Suitability
mocks.w: This is Trail commission. Trail commission is paid to a distributor as long as the investor stays invested, usually as a percentage of the assets he has brought in.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: SEBI sets maximum TER slabs that fall as a scheme's assets under management grow, so larger schemes charge a lower percentage.
For tax purposes, an equity-oriented fund invests at least 65% of its assets in equity shares of domestic companies.
A specified mutual fund invests more than 65% in debt and money-market instruments. Gains on units bought from April 2023 are taxed at the investor's slab rate regardless of holding period.
Long-term equity gains are taxed from the first rupee.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Gains on equity-oriented funds held over 12 months are taxed at 12.5% on the amount above ₹1.25 lakh in a financial year.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A TRI reflects both price changes and reinvested dividends of the index constituents, and is the proper benchmark for comparison with a fund's returns.
Beta measures the fund's absolute return.
YTM is the annualised return earned if a bond is held to maturity and all coupons are reinvested at the same rate.
Compound Annual Growth Rate is the constant yearly rate at which an investment would have grown to reach its final value, used for periods over one year.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Beta measures a fund's sensitivity to the market. A beta of 1.2 means it is expected to move 20% more than the market.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Time horizon” is correct?
o: Bonds make the holder an owner of the company.
Only pre-tax returns matter in a comparison.
The time horizon is the period for which money will be invested before it is needed; longer horizons can support more equity.
Time horizon has no effect on product choice.
mocks.w: Correct: The time horizon is the period for which money will be invested before it is needed; longer horizons can support more equity.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Conflicts of interest need not be disclosed.
A model portfolio is a pre-defined allocation for a risk profile, used as a template and customised for the client.
A core and satellite approach holds the bulk of the portfolio in stable, low-cost funds and a smaller satellite part in higher-conviction ideas.
A glide path gradually reduces equity and raises safer assets as a goal date approaches, to protect accumulated gains.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A conflict of interest arises when the distributor's earnings could bias the advice; it must be disclosed and managed in the client's favour.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The Code of Conduct allows promising assured returns.
Stamp duty is charged at 0.005% on the purchase of mutual fund units, including switches and SIP instalments.
The Association of Mutual Funds in India is the industry body of AMCs. It sets best practices, issues the ARN to distributors, and publishes the daily NAVs.
SEBI groups schemes into equity, debt, hybrid, solution oriented and other categories with defined definitions, and each AMC may offer only one scheme per category, with a few exceptions.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: AMFI's Code of Conduct requires distributors to act honestly, disclose commissions, give suitable advice, and not mislead investors.

mocks.p: A debt fund bought in 2024 and held for four years is taxed at the investor's slab rate. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Slab-wise TER
Specified mutual fund
NAV calculation
Debt valuation
mocks.w: This is Specified mutual fund. A specified mutual fund invests more than 65% in debt and money-market instruments. Gains on units bought from April 2023 are taxed at the investor's slab rate regardless of holding period.

mocks.p: A scheme designed for a child's education has a five-year lock-in. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Solution-oriented funds
Arbitrage fund
Value and contra funds
Index fund and ETF
mocks.w: This is Solution-oriented funds. Retirement and children's funds have a lock-in of five years or until retirement age or the child turns 18, whichever is earlier.

mocks.p: A scheme keeps 70% in stocks ranked 101 to 250. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Gilt fund
Large cap fund
Mid cap fund
Solution-oriented funds
mocks.w: This is Mid cap fund. A mid cap fund invests at least 65% in companies ranked 101 to 250 by market capitalisation.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Liquid fund” is correct?
o: Solution-oriented funds have no lock-in.
A flexi cap fund must hold 25% in each market-cap band.
A liquid fund invests in debt and money-market securities with a maturity of up to 91 days.
A liquid fund holds securities of up to three years.
mocks.w: Correct: A liquid fund invests in debt and money-market securities with a maturity of up to 91 days.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The SAI holds information common to the fund house and all its schemes: constitution, sponsor, trustees, AMC, service providers and legal details.
Units must be allotted and refunds, if any, paid within five working days from the closure of the NFO.
A scheme at ₹10 is cheaper in value than one at ₹50.
The offer document lists the risks specific to the scheme, such as credit risk for debt schemes, so that investors make informed decisions.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Units in an NFO are typically offered at ₹10 each, with no assurance that this is a better price than existing schemes' NAV.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Beta measures a fund's sensitivity to the market. A beta of 1.2 means it is expected to move 20% more than the market.
Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.
A negative alpha shows outperformance.
Liquidity risk is the chance a fund cannot sell securities quickly without a price discount, such as in thinly traded bonds.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Alpha is the excess return of a fund over what its risk (beta) would predict, showing the value added by the fund manager.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Open-ended scheme” is correct?
o: Pooling increases the cost per unit for every investor.
All mutual fund units can be encashed instantly at any hour.
An open-ended scheme accepts purchases and redemptions at NAV on every business day after launch and has no fixed maturity.
An open-ended scheme can be redeemed only on maturity.
mocks.w: Correct: An open-ended scheme accepts purchases and redemptions at NAV on every business day after launch and has no fixed maturity.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: An STP moves money to the investor's bank account.
A folio is the account number allotted by an AMC to an investor, under which all that investor's units in that fund house are recorded.
A Systematic Investment Plan invests a fixed amount at regular intervals, which averages the purchase cost and builds discipline.
A Systematic Withdrawal Plan redeems a fixed amount of units at regular intervals, giving the investor a regular cash flow.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A Systematic Transfer Plan transfers a fixed amount at regular intervals from one scheme to another within the same fund house.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Entry load” is correct?
o: Exit load is paid to the distributor.
Entry load of 2.25% is still allowed on purchases.
NAV is declared once a week.
SEBI has abolished entry load; no fee can be deducted from the investor's money at the time of purchase.
mocks.w: Correct: SEBI has abolished entry load; no fee can be deducted from the investor's money at the time of purchase.

mocks.p: A client needing money in 6 months should avoid a high-equity scheme. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Bonds and debentures
Life insurance versus investment
Risk profiling
Time horizon
mocks.w: This is Time horizon. The time horizon is the period for which money will be invested before it is needed; longer horizons can support more equity.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.
A price index is the preferred benchmark because it includes dividends.
Higher potential return generally comes with higher risk. Investors who want higher returns must accept greater volatility.
XIRR is the annualised return when there are multiple cash flows on different dates, such as SIP instalments.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A TRI reflects both price changes and reinvested dividends of the index constituents, and is the proper benchmark for comparison with a fund's returns.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The NAV applied to a transaction depends on the cut-off time and when the funds are available for use by the scheme, not just when the application is made.
Bank details cannot be changed after the first investment.
A switch is moving investment from one scheme to another, or between plans or options in the same scheme; it is treated as redemption and fresh purchase.
A minor's folio is operated by a guardian, and when the minor turns 18 a fresh KYC is needed, and the guardian's operation stops.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A change of bank details needs a written request with proof of the new bank and is checked by the RTA; some schemes impose a cooling-off for large redemptions.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Yield to maturity (YTM)” is correct?
o: A negative alpha shows outperformance.
A high tracking error is desirable for index funds.
YTM is the annualised return earned if a bond is held to maturity and all coupons are reinvested at the same rate.
YTM is the coupon rate printed on the bond.
mocks.w: Correct: YTM is the annualised return earned if a bond is held to maturity and all coupons are reinvested at the same rate.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A mutual fund is a trust that pools money from many investors and invests it in securities such as shares and bonds, managed by professionals for the benefit of unit holders.
A closed-ended scheme has a fixed maturity and units are bought during the NFO only; investors exit at maturity or by selling on a stock exchange where listed.
Mutual funds are as safe as a bank fixed deposit.
Economies of scale mean that large pooled funds can buy securities in bulk and spread costs, lowering per-unit costs for investors.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risk. The value of units can rise and fall, and past performance does not assure future results.

mocks.p: A portfolio holds 70% in index funds and 30% in a thematic fund. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Core and satellite
Documenting advice
Strategic asset allocation
Conflict of interest
mocks.w: This is Core and satellite. A core and satellite approach holds the bulk of the portfolio in stable, low-cost funds and a smaller satellite part in higher-conviction ideas.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A switch is moving investment from one scheme to another, or between plans or options in the same scheme; it is treated as redemption and fresh purchase.
In 'anyone or survivor' mode all holders must sign each redemption.
Nomination lets a holder name a person who will receive the units on the holder's death. Nominees are not the legal owners; they hold the proceeds for the legal heirs.
A change of bank details needs a written request with proof of the new bank and is checked by the RTA; some schemes impose a cooling-off for large redemptions.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: In 'anyone or survivor' mode, any holder can operate the folio; in 'joint', all must sign. On a holder's death the units go to the survivors.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Upfront commission” is correct?
o: The only channel to buy mutual funds is a bank branch.
Distributors can still take a large upfront commission.
Churning benefits the investor through lower costs.
SEBI has banned upfront commission to distributors; commissions are now paid on a trail basis, to align the distributor's interest with the investor's.
mocks.w: Correct: SEBI has banned upfront commission to distributors; commissions are now paid on a trail basis, to align the distributor's interest with the investor's.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A step-up SIP reduces the instalment each year.
Goal-based planning sets investments against specific goals, such as a child's education, with a target amount, date and priority.
An emergency fund is money kept in safe and liquid assets, usually three to six months of expenses, for unexpected needs.
Money today is worth more than the same sum in the future because it can earn returns; planning must discount future needs and compound savings.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A step-up SIP increases the instalment amount at regular intervals, usually yearly, in line with rising income.

mocks.p: After the death of a sole holder, the nominee submits the death certificate to claim the units. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Dividend or IDCW payout timeline
SIP
Transmission
Minor investor
mocks.w: This is Transmission. Transmission is the transfer of units to the legal heirs or surviving holders on the death of a holder, supported by documents like the death certificate.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Real estate offers potential for appreciation and rental income but is illiquid, needs large capital and has high transaction costs.
Risk profile is the same for every client of the same age.
Gold is held as a hedge against inflation and uncertainty; it can be owned through physical gold, gold ETFs, sovereign gold bonds or gold funds.
Pure term insurance protects against loss of life; it should be separated from investment, and mutual funds are not insurance products.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Risk profiling assesses a client's capacity and willingness to take risk through questions on age, income, dependants, goals and past behaviour, and guides product choice.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: An NFO can stay open for six months.
Units in an NFO are typically offered at ₹10 each, with no assurance that this is a better price than existing schemes' NAV.
The SAI holds information common to the fund house and all its schemes: constitution, sponsor, trustees, AMC, service providers and legal details.
The SID contains scheme-specific details: investment objective, asset allocation, strategy, risk factors, load structure, benchmark and fees.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: An NFO is the initial offer of a new scheme's units to the public. The offer period cannot exceed 15 days.

mocks.p: A scheme keeps 20% in equity and 80% in debt. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Conservative hybrid fund
Credit risk fund
Small cap fund
Index fund and ETF
mocks.w: This is Conservative hybrid fund. A conservative hybrid fund invests 10% to 25% in equity and 75% to 90% in debt.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Gold pays regular interest on holdings.
The time horizon is the period for which money will be invested before it is needed; longer horizons can support more equity.
Real estate offers potential for appreciation and rental income but is illiquid, needs large capital and has high transaction costs.
Risk profiling assesses a client's capacity and willingness to take risk through questions on age, income, dependants, goals and past behaviour, and guides product choice.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Gold is held as a hedge against inflation and uncertainty; it can be owned through physical gold, gold ETFs, sovereign gold bonds or gold funds.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A step-up SIP increases the instalment amount at regular intervals, usually yearly, in line with rising income.
A client's life stage, such as starting a career, raising a family or nearing retirement, shapes goals, risk capacity and asset allocation.
Retirement planning estimates the corpus needed to meet expenses after earning stops, allowing for inflation and longevity.
An emergency fund should be invested in small-cap equity.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: An emergency fund is money kept in safe and liquid assets, usually three to six months of expenses, for unexpected needs.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The KIM is a short summary of the SID and SAI given with the application form so investors see the essentials first. SEBI has since moved towards a standard scheme summary document with the same purpose.
Units in an NFO are typically offered at ₹10 each, with no assurance that this is a better price than existing schemes' NAV.
The SID contains only the fund house's history.
Units must be allotted and refunds, if any, paid within five working days from the closure of the NFO.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: The SID contains scheme-specific details: investment objective, asset allocation, strategy, risk factors, load structure, benchmark and fees.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Mutual funds disclose NAV daily, portfolios monthly and factsheets regularly, so investors can see where their money is invested.
Liquidity in mutual funds means that units of open-ended schemes can be redeemed on any business day at the applicable NAV, subject to exit loads and settlement time.
A mutual fund guarantees a fixed return to every investor.
A closed-ended scheme has a fixed maturity and units are bought during the NFO only; investors exit at maturity or by selling on a stock exchange where listed.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A mutual fund is a trust that pools money from many investors and invests it in securities such as shares and bonds, managed by professionals for the benefit of unit holders.

mocks.p: A father invests on behalf of his twelve-year-old daughter. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Lien
Dividend or IDCW payout timeline
Transmission
Minor investor
mocks.w: This is Minor investor. A minor's folio is operated by a guardian, and when the minor turns 18 a fresh KYC is needed, and the guardian's operation stops.

mocks.p: A manager temporarily raises debt above target because equities look expensive. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Asset allocation
Tactical asset allocation
Model portfolio
Glide path
mocks.w: This is Tactical asset allocation. Tactical allocation makes short-term deviations from the strategic weights to take advantage of market conditions.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Credit risk is the chance that a bond issuer fails to pay interest or principal on time. Lower-rated issuers carry higher credit risk.
Modified duration estimates the percentage change in a bond's price for a 1% change in yield. A higher duration means more interest-rate sensitivity.
Tracking error is the standard deviation of the difference between an index fund's return and its benchmark's. A lower figure means closer replication.
Liquidity risk affects only equity funds.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Liquidity risk is the chance a fund cannot sell securities quickly without a price discount, such as in thinly traded bonds.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Economies of scale” is correct?
o: A mutual fund guarantees a fixed return to every investor.
A fund with a low NAV is cheaper and therefore a better buy.
Pooling increases the cost per unit for every investor.
Economies of scale mean that large pooled funds can buy securities in bulk and spread costs, lowering per-unit costs for investors.
mocks.w: Correct: Economies of scale mean that large pooled funds can buy securities in bulk and spread costs, lowering per-unit costs for investors.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: When interest rates rise, the prices of existing bonds fall and vice versa, which affects debt fund NAVs, especially of longer-duration funds.
High returns can be earned without any additional risk.
Absolute return is the percentage change in value over a period, ignoring how long it took. It is (end value − start value) ÷ start value.
A TRI reflects both price changes and reinvested dividends of the index constituents, and is the proper benchmark for comparison with a fund's returns.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Higher potential return generally comes with higher risk. Investors who want higher returns must accept greater volatility.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The KIM is a short summary of the SID and SAI given with the application form so investors see the essentials first. SEBI has since moved towards a standard scheme summary document with the same purpose.
An NFO is the initial offer of a new scheme's units to the public. The offer period cannot exceed 15 days.
The SID contains scheme-specific details: investment objective, asset allocation, strategy, risk factors, load structure, benchmark and fees.
Risk factors are required only for equity schemes.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: The offer document lists the risks specific to the scheme, such as credit risk for debt schemes, so that investors make informed decisions.

mocks.p: A bank group creates a new fund house and registers its trust with SEBI. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Sponsor
Trustees
Mutual fund as a trust
Fund accountant and auditor
mocks.w: This is Sponsor. The sponsor is the person or entity that sets up the mutual fund and establishes the trust. It must meet SEBI's track-record and net-worth conditions.

mocks.p: A distributor tells the client how much she will earn on the recommended scheme. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Upfront commission
Direct plan
Trail commission
Disclosure of commission
mocks.w: This is Disclosure of commission. A distributor must disclose to the investor all commissions received from the AMC for the transaction, in a transparent manner.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Small cap fund” is correct?
o: A flexi cap fund must hold 25% in each market-cap band.
A mid cap fund invests mainly in the top 100 companies.
A small cap fund must hold at least 80% in the top 100.
A small cap fund invests at least 65% in companies ranked 251 and below by market capitalisation.
mocks.w: Correct: A small cap fund invests at least 65% in companies ranked 251 and below by market capitalisation.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The distributor should record the client's profile, the recommendation and the reasons, and obtain the client's acknowledgement to show suitability.
Rebalancing means bringing the portfolio back to its target allocation by selling what has grown too large and buying what has fallen behind.
Strategic asset allocation sets long-term target weights based on the client's profile, which are maintained by periodic rebalancing.
The rule fixes the exact equity percentage for everyone of a given age.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A rough guide sets equity at 100 minus the investor's age, adjusting for risk profile; it is a starting point, not a rule.

mocks.p: Which statement about “ELSS” is correct?
o: ELSS has a lock-in of one year.
A small cap fund must hold at least 80% in the top 100.
An Equity Linked Savings Scheme invests at least 80% in equity and has a three-year lock-in, and qualifies for the old tax regime deduction under Section 80C.
A value fund buys only stocks at record highs.
mocks.w: Correct: An Equity Linked Savings Scheme invests at least 80% in equity and has a three-year lock-in, and qualifies for the old tax regime deduction under Section 80C.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A mutual fund provides life cover.
Risk profiling assesses a client's capacity and willingness to take risk through questions on age, income, dependants, goals and past behaviour, and guides product choice.
The after-tax return matters more than the headline return; different products are taxed differently, so compare after-tax outcomes.
Inflation is the rise in prices over time, which erodes the purchasing power of money; investments must beat it to grow real wealth.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Pure term insurance protects against loss of life; it should be separated from investment, and mutual funds are not insurance products.

mocks.p: An investor shifts from a large-cap fund to a debt fund of the same AMC. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Switch
Minor investor
Demat mode
Folio
mocks.w: This is Switch. A switch is moving investment from one scheme to another, or between plans or options in the same scheme; it is treated as redemption and fresh purchase.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Trustees hold the fund's property in trust for unit holders and supervise the AMC. At least two-thirds of the trustees must be independent of the sponsor.
The sponsor need not contribute to the AMC's net worth.
The custodian safekeeps the securities and settles the trades of the schemes, and is independent of the sponsor.
The fund accountant maintains the scheme's books and computes NAV, while auditors independently audit the accounts.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: The sponsor must contribute at least 40% of the net worth of the AMC.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Distributor channels” is correct?
o: AMCs pay commissions without checking the distributor's registration.
The only channel to buy mutual funds is a bank branch.
Commissions are confidential and need not be disclosed.
Mutual fund distribution channels include independent financial advisers, national distributors, banks, and online platforms and direct AMC routes.
mocks.w: Correct: Mutual fund distribution channels include independent financial advisers, national distributors, banks, and online platforms and direct AMC routes.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Listed equity shares are valued at the closing price on the principal stock exchange on the valuation day.
Entry load of 2.25% is still allowed on purchases.
NAV equals the market value of the scheme's assets less its liabilities, divided by units outstanding, and is declared every business day.
Exit load is a charge levied when units are redeemed within a stated period. It is credited to the scheme, not kept by the AMC.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: SEBI has abolished entry load; no fee can be deducted from the investor's money at the time of purchase.

mocks.p: A fund house must obtain a certificate of registration before launching schemes. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: EUIN
SEBI
Code of Conduct
KYC
mocks.w: This is SEBI. The Securities and Exchange Board of India is the statutory regulator that registers and regulates mutual funds and protects investors under the SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Arbitrage fund” is correct?
o: A thematic fund is well diversified across all sectors.
An arbitrage fund takes a large one-sided view on stocks.
A liquid fund holds securities of up to three years.
An arbitrage fund invests at least 65% in equity and equity-related instruments and profits from price differences between cash and futures markets; it is taxed as equity.
mocks.w: Correct: An arbitrage fund invests at least 65% in equity and equity-related instruments and profits from price differences between cash and futures markets; it is taxed as equity.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The cut-off time is the time of day by which a valid application with funds must be received to get that day's NAV. For most schemes it is 3:00 pm.
A folio is a type of scheme.
Nomination lets a holder name a person who will receive the units on the holder's death. Nominees are not the legal owners; they hold the proceeds for the legal heirs.
A lien is a charge marked on units, for example when pledged as security for a loan, so they cannot be redeemed until the lien is removed.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A folio is the account number allotted by an AMC to an investor, under which all that investor's units in that fund house are recorded.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A model portfolio is a pre-defined allocation for a risk profile, used as a template and customised for the client.
A rough guide sets equity at 100 minus the investor's age, adjusting for risk profile; it is a starting point, not a rule.
A conflict of interest arises when the distributor's earnings could bias the advice; it must be disclosed and managed in the client's favour.
A glide path raises equity as the goal date approaches.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: A glide path gradually reduces equity and raises safer assets as a goal date approaches, to protect accumulated gains.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Listed equity shares are valued at the closing price on the principal stock exchange on the valuation day.
Gains on equity-oriented funds sold within 12 months are short-term and taxed at 20%.
IDCW is tax-free in the hands of all investors.
Securities Transaction Tax is levied on the redemption of equity-oriented fund units; there is no STT on purchase, and none on debt funds.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Income distribution cum capital withdrawal payouts are added to the investor's income and taxed at the slab rate, with TDS where applicable.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: The after-tax return matters more than the headline return; different products are taxed differently, so compare after-tax outcomes.
Gold is held as a hedge against inflation and uncertainty; it can be owned through physical gold, gold ETFs, sovereign gold bonds or gold funds.
Pure term insurance protects against loss of life; it should be separated from investment, and mutual funds are not insurance products.
Mutual funds provide guaranteed capital protection.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Mutual fund schemes do not protect capital; only specific instruments like bank deposits (up to the insured limit) and some government schemes offer greater safety.

mocks.p: An investor with no time for research relies on a team that tracks companies full time. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Interval scheme
Professional management
Mutual fund
Net Asset Value (NAV)
mocks.w: This is Professional management. Professional management means a qualified fund manager and research team select and monitor securities for the scheme, for a fee charged as part of the expense ratio.

mocks.p: A bond fund with a duration of 5 falls about 5% if yields rise 1%. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Alpha
Total Return Index (TRI)
Modified duration
Absolute return
mocks.w: This is Modified duration. Modified duration estimates the percentage change in a bond's price for a 1% change in yield. A higher duration means more interest-rate sensitivity.

mocks.p: A SIP buys more units during a fall in the market. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Applicable NAV
Rupee cost averaging
Switch
Consolidated Account Statement (CAS)
mocks.w: This is Rupee cost averaging. Rupee cost averaging means a fixed amount buys more units when NAV is low and fewer when it is high, lowering the average cost per unit over time.

mocks.p: An investor checks last month's holdings on a fund house's site. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Code of Conduct
SEBI
Fundamental attribute change
Portfolio disclosure
mocks.w: This is Portfolio disclosure. Mutual funds publish portfolios of all schemes monthly on their websites and with AMFI, and publish the half-yearly financial results.

mocks.p: A first-time investor is asked for PAN, address proof and a photograph. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Product labelling
KYC
Fundamental attribute change
Portfolio disclosure
mocks.w: This is KYC. Know Your Customer is mandatory for all mutual fund investors. It verifies identity and address, and the records are kept with a KYC registration agency.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Retirement planning” is correct?
o: A rupee today has the same value as a rupee in ten years.
Retirement planning needs no allowance for inflation.
Retirement planning estimates the corpus needed to meet expenses after earning stops, allowing for inflation and longevity.
Goal-based planning ignores timelines.
mocks.w: Correct: Retirement planning estimates the corpus needed to meet expenses after earning stops, allowing for inflation and longevity.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: A person cannot be both a registered investment adviser and a distributor for the same client; roles and fees must be kept clearly separate to avoid conflicts of interest.
Mis-selling is selling a product that is unsuitable for the client or by misrepresenting its features, risk or returns.
Churning is persuading an investor to frequently switch schemes mainly to earn the distributor more commission, with little or no benefit to the investor.
AMCs pay commissions without checking the distributor's registration.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: AMCs carry out due diligence on distributors and check that their ARN, certification and code compliance are valid before accepting business.

mocks.p: Which of these statements is NOT correct?
o: Standard deviation measures how much a fund's returns vary around its average. A higher figure means more volatility.
YTM is the annualised return earned if a bond is held to maturity and all coupons are reinvested at the same rate.
Beta measures a fund's sensitivity to the market. A beta of 1.2 means it is expected to move 20% more than the market.
Absolute return already adjusts for the length of time.
mocks.w: That statement is a common misunderstanding. The accurate position: Absolute return is the percentage change in value over a period, ignoring how long it took. It is (end value − start value) ÷ start value.

mocks.p: A distributor shows a typical moderate-risk allocation as a starting point. Which idea does this illustrate?
o: Model portfolio
Age-based rule of thumb
Strategic asset allocation
Documenting advice
mocks.w: This is Model portfolio. A model portfolio is a pre-defined allocation for a risk profile, used as a template and customised for the client.

mocks.p: Which statement about “Asset allocation pattern” is correct?
o: A scheme at ₹10 is cheaper in value than one at ₹50.
The SID states the proportion of the scheme's assets to be held in each asset class and the permissible ranges, which are binding on the fund manager.
The fund manager can ignore the stated asset allocation.
Risk factors are required only for equity schemes.
